Class LessonsLearned.Experience

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonsLearned.Experience
Enclosing class:
LessonsLearned
public static class LessonsLearned.Experience extends Object

Title: Experience Class

Description: One experience entry for a lesson learned (C-3). Each time someone tries to use a lesson again, the contributor records what was done, how it was done, how long it took, and the effort used by the team members. These are the same four fields as the Role1 page's experience boxes and the experienceDB table (DB), so they are stored as text.

  • Constructor Details

    • Experience

      public Experience(String contributor, String whatWasDone, String howItWasDone, String timeTaken, String teamEffort)

      Method: Experience(String contributor, String whatWasDone, String howItWasDone, String timeTaken, String teamEffort)

      Description: Creates an experience entry that hasn't been saved yet (C-3). The parameters are in the same order as Database.addExperience.

      Parameters:
      contributor - is the userName of the contributor adding the entry
      whatWasDone - is what was done
      howItWasDone - is how it was done
      timeTaken - is how long it took
      teamEffort - is the effort used by each team member
